{{2018–19 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}}

The '''2018–19 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Oregon]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Ducks, led by ninth-year head coach [[Dana Altman]], played their home games at [[Matthew Knight Arena]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac–12 Conference]]. They finished the season with a 25–13 record, 10–8 in conference play, and finished tied for 4th in the Pac-12.<ref>{{cite web |title=2018-19 Oregon Ducks Roster and Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/oregon/2019.html |accessdate=23 March 2019 |df=mdy-all}}</ref> Oregon won the [[2019 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], upsetting the No. 1 seed [[2018–19 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] and receiving the conference's automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Martini |first1=Pete |title=Oregon Ducks win Pac-12 title, clinch NCAA tournament berth |url=https://www.statesmanjournal.com/story/sports/college/univ-oregon/2019/03/16/live-updates-oregon-ducks-basketball-goes-pac-12-title/3191922002/ |accessdate=23 March 2019 |df=mdy-all}}</ref> Oregon entered the NCAA Tournament as a No. 12 seed and upset the No. 5 seed [[2018–19 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] in the first round, beat [[2018–19 UC Irvine Anteaters men's basketball team|UC Irvine]] in the Second Round before losing in the Sweet Sixteen to [[2018–19 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]].

==Previous season==
{{main|2017–18 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team}}

The [[2017–18 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Ducks]] finished the season 23–13, 10–8 in [[2017-18 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in a tie for sixth place. As the No. 6 seed in the [[2018 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] in the first round and [[2017–18 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]] in the quarterfinals before being defeated by [[2017–18 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]] in the semifinals. They received an invitation to the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they defeated [[2017–18 Rider Broncs men's basketball team|Rider]] in the first round before losing to [[2017–18 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]] in the second round.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://goducks.com/news/2018/3/18/mens-basketball-ducks-season-ends-in-nit-second-round-loss-at-marquette.aspx?path=mbball|title=Ducks' season ends in NIT second round loss at Marquette|website=GoDucks.com|publisher=University of Oregon Athletics|accessdate=23 June 2018 |df=mdy-all}}</ref>
